why: A marketplace counting cash in whole dollars (fm-server#1059). cashDecimals is 0, which a parser defaulting on a falsey value rather than an absent one reads as 2, and every holding then shows a hundredth of what it holds.

source.constructed: fm-server does not send cashDecimals yet (fm-server#1060); this is the shape docs/PRICE-SCALE.md section 3.1 gives it. Its one market counts whole dollars and whole units, so cashDecimals = priceDecimals + unitDecimals = 0.
